items.defectStatement: When no filter is present, getBaseConditions returns a team/org authorization OR expression without enclosing parentheses. Appending AND extra therefore applies extra only to the last OR branch, allowing earlier branches to bypass the extra restriction; this does not itself bypass the base authorization predicate.
obligations: Ensure an appended AND predicate applies to every branch of the returned condition.
Preserve the intersection of authorization and filters when both exist.
Preserve parameterized SQL and deny-all behavior.
items.notes: Wrapping at this boundary suffices; changing the eventTypeId fragment elsewhere is unnecessary. The both-present branch already groups its operands correctly for appended AND. No production caller using the hazardous composition was found.
